description: The plot titled “Finetuning for different r, WikiHow” illustrates how ROUGE-1 varies with the parameter shown on the x-axis for four methods. The x-axis is labeled “log r,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 9 with integer tick marks at each value. The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 40 with regularly spaced tick labels every 5 units. Four solid lines with circular markers are shown: a red line (label text in the legend is obscured) starts near 23 at log r = 0, rises through about 24.5 (1) and 26.8 (2) to about 28.4–28.6 around log r = 3–5, then gradually declines to about 27.0 by log r = 9; a blue line labeled “MBart + LoRA” starts near 12 at log r = 0, drops to about 5 at log r = 1, then increases to about 20.2 (2), 24.4 (3), and about 27.0–27.2 around log r = 4–5, staying roughly flat near 27.0 through log r = 9; a green line labeled “T5 + AdaLoRA” starts near 23 at log r = 0, increases to about 26.3 (1), 30.0 (2), 33.3 (3), and about 36.0 by log r = 4, then remains essentially flat around 36.0–36.1 from log r = 4 through 9; an orange line labeled “MBart + AdaLoRA” starts near 12 at log r = 0, rises to about 14.0 (1), 21.3 (2), 29.0 (3), and about 31.2 (4), then continues increasing more gradually to about 33.0 (6) and about 33.4–33.5 by log r = 9.
